AddDeviceAddedFilteringNotAvailable: Your device has been added with Filtering Mode disabled. You will still be able to ping and monitor servers in real-time. Filtering Mode is not currently supported for this game.
AddDeviceAddedWithFiltering:
Your device has been added in Filtering Mode.

If you experience issues when connecting to the internet, consider disabling Filtering Mode or changing your filter settings to allow more servers to connect.
AddDeviceAddedWithoutFiltering:
Your device has been added with Filtering Mode disabled.

You will still be able to ping and monitor servers in real-time. You can begin filtering at any time by enabling Filtering Mode.
AddDeviceConsoleGuide:
When using the Geo-Filter to block servers, some games will respond better than others.

Use the recommended mode for your game to achieve the best results.
AddDeviceFilteringModeNotRecommendedBody:
{{device}} cannot be filtered, as this would prevent you from being able to play online without issues.

Select 'Use Recommended Setting' to disable filtering for this device. This will still allow you to see other servers / connections on the map and use the Ping features.
AddDeviceFilteringModeRecommendedBody:
{{device}} can be filtered to find the lowest ping servers without issues.

Select 'Use Recommended Setting' to enable filtering for this device. This will allow you to block servers by distance and by ping.
AddDeviceManualModeSelection:
In Filtering Mode, servers will be blocked by distance and ping. Some games may experience connection problems with Filtering Mode.

With Filtering Mode disabled, you will still be able to view and ping servers, but you will not block servers and the game will connect normally.
CouldntAddDeviceDialogBody: Unable to add device because some devices are overlapping
DeleteDeviceDialogBody: Are you sure you want to delete {{device}}
GameFilteringUnavailableText: Filtering Mode is not currently supported for this game. However, you can still use Geo-Filter to ping and monitor game servers.
MaximumDevicesExceededMessage: Geo-Filter supports up to 4 devices at a time. To add a new device, remove one of the devices currently in your Geo-Filter.
PingFailed: Server could not be pinged at this time
RecommendModeForGame: Recommend a mode for my game
TourCancelled: To take this tour again, open this options menu and press Start Tour.
TourDisableDevice: You can use this toggle to disable Filtering Mode at any time. Game activity will still be displayed on the map, but nothing will be blocked.
TourFilterSize: Change the Filter Size to block bad game servers outside your filter.
TourFinished: All finished! Check back here the next time you play a game to improve your ping. $t(TourCancelled)
TourMap: When you start playing, servers will appear on the map. Adjust your filter to get the best servers for games you play.
TourMapIcons: Game servers outside of your filter will be blocked the next time you play.
TourPingAssist: Use Ping Assist to set a maximum ping and connect to fast servers outside of your filter.
TourPolygonMode: Draw shapes around the areas you'd like to connect to, using up to 50 points.
tourCoverPageContent: The $t(branding:com.netdumasoftware.geofilter) can improve your gameplay by keeping your games close to home and blocking distant laggy servers.
